name: addToOrder
description: Add a product to the current order

product.description: The name of the product to add

name: removeFromOrder
description: Remove a product from the current order

product.description: The name of the product to remove

name: updateOrderItem
description: Update the quantity of a product in the current order

product.description: The name of the product to update

name: getCurrentOrder
description: Get the current order with all items and total

name: clearOrder
description: Clear all items from the current order

name: scheduleOrder
description: Schedule an order for a specific date and time within the next 5 days

product.description: The name of the product to schedule

time.description: The time in HH:MM format (e.g., 10:00 for 10 AM, 19:00 for 7 PM)

name: cancelScheduledOrder
description: Cancel a scheduled order by its ID

orderId.description: The ID of the scheduled order to cancel (e.g., SCH-0001)
